best practices for validating file extensions in Node.js
parameters.snippet:
# Check if the filename has a valid audio file extension
def is_valid_audio_file(filename):
    valid_extensions = ['.mp3', '.wav', '.aac', '.flac']
    return any(filename.endswith(ext) for ext in valid_extensions)

# Example usage
filename = "peters_mixtape.mp3"
assert is_valid_audio_file(filename) == True
